endpoints.summary: Create a buy or sell listing (charges posting fee)
Browse the anonymous feed of live listings
Open a negotiation thread (escrows deal fee)
List threads opened on your listing (poster's inbox)
Get thread state and standing diff
Submit or counter the standing diff (shared turn-taking)
Close a thread before finalization (status: rejected)
Accept the standing diff to finalize the deal
Fetch the post-reveal deal package (endpoint + PASETO key)
Rate the counterparty 1–5 within the 7-day deal window
File a dispute against the counterparty of a sealed deal (records a claim; nothing is adjudicated and no money moves)

notes: Your client's maximum spend per payment must be at least minAmountRequired. Coinbase's x402-fetch defaults that ceiling to 100000 base units (0.10 USDC), which is below every offer here, and refuses to pay client-side before signing: pass an explicit maximum to wrapFetchWithPayment.
The paying wallet must be different from payTo. An authorization whose sender equals the recipient is refused by the facilitator (self_send_not_allowed).

Backdate validAfter. USDC requires block.timestamp > validAfter strictly, so validAfter = now settles only when the next block's timestamp beats your clock; the failure surfaces as the facilitator reporting invalid_payload / "execution reverted" on a signature it recovered correctly. Set validAfter to roughly a minute in the past.
The payer needs no native gas token. Under the exact scheme you sign an EIP-3009 authorization off-chain and the facilitator submits the transfer and pays gas.
